content:
Here is the idiomatic `knr-ops` implementation for the new logs bucket, IRSA, and Flux reconciliation. The structure follows GitOps best practices: **base** contains shared ACK manifests, **overlays** apply environment-specific patches, and **Flux** drives deployment with SOPS decryption.

### 📁 Directory Structure
```
infra/
├── s3/
│   ├── base/
│   │   ├── bucket.yaml
│   │   ├── irsa-role.yaml
│   │   ├── irsa-policy.yaml
│   │   └── kustomization.yaml
│   └── overlays/
│       ├── dev/
│       │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│       │   └── patches.yaml
│       └── prod/
│           ├── kustomization.yaml
│           └── patches.yaml
└── flux/
    └── kustomizations.yaml  # Append the new Kustomization here
```

---

### 📦 Base Manifests

#### `infra/s3/base/kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - irsa-role.yaml
  - irsa-policy.yaml
```

#### `infra/s3/base/bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    versioning:
      - status: Enabled
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      - rule:
          applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            sseAlgorithm: AES256
    publicAccessBlock:
      - blockPublicAcls: true
        blockPublicPolicy: true
        ignorePublicAcls: true
        restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

#### `infra/s3/base/irsa-role.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::PLACEHOLDER_ACCOUNT:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.PLACEHOLDER_REGION.id.amazonaws.com/CLUSTER_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.PLACEHOLDER_REGION.id.amazonaws.com/CLUSTER_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp-logs-sa"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

#### `infra/s3/base/irsa-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:DeleteObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
  dependsOn:
    - kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
```

---

### 🔄 Kustomize Overlays

#### `infra/s3/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patches.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
  - path: patches.yaml
    target:
      kind: Policy
      name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
  - path: patches.yaml
    target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
```

#### `infra/s3/overlays/dev/patches.yaml`
```yaml
- op: replace
  path: /metadata/name
  value: myapp-logs-dev
- op: replace
  path: /spec/forProvider/name
  value: myapp-logs-dev
- op: replace
  path: /spec/forProvider/policy
  value: >
    {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:AbortMultipartUpload","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev","arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"]}]}
- op: replace
  path: /spec/forProvider/assumeRolePolicy
  value: >
    {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.id.amazonaws.com/DEV_CLUSTER_ID"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"oidc.eks.us-east-1.id.amazonaws.com/DEV_CLUSTER_ID:sub":"system:serviceaccount:default:myapp-logs-sa"}}}]}
```

*(Repeat `overlays/prod/` with `myapp-logs-prod`, prod account/cluster IDs, and prod-compliant least-privilege actions if required.)*

---

### ⚙️ Flux Kustomization

Append this to `infra/flux/kustomizations.yaml` (or add to a `flux/sources/` directory depending on your repo layout):

```yaml
- apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
  kind: Kustomization
  metadata:
    name: knr-ops-s3-logs
    namespace: flux-system
  spec:
    interval: 10m0s
    path: "./infra/s3/overlays/dev" # Swap to /prod for prod reconciler
    targetNamespace: default
    sourceRef:
      kind: GitRepository
      name: knr-ops
    decryption:
      provider: sops
      secretRef:
        name: sops-age
    postBuild:
      substituteFrom:
        - kind: ConfigMap
          name: knr-ops-vars
    # Optional: ensure ACK controllers are ready before reconciling ACK CRDs
    dependsOn:
      - name: knr-ops-ack
```

---
